newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss couple arrested in child-sex probe.
newsitem.headline: Swiss couple arrested in child-sex probe.

text.p: A Swiss couple who used newspaper ads to get babysitting jobs have been arrested on suspicion of sexually abusing young children in their care and selling videotapes they made of the acts, police said on Friday.
Berne cantonal police confirmed media reports of the case and said they had arrested a man, 29, and a 27-year-old woman in the town of Bienne at the end of December and early this month.

"They are suspected of committing sexual acts with young children over several years," police said, without naming the suspects. Investigators also seized a large amount of pornographic videos, photographs and diskettes from them.
"Both persons are suspected of trafficking in such material that they made themelves," police said in a statement.
